findings.text: Load verification treats the stored pointer at a single index as authoritative: the helper fetches the current entry and a mismatch against the expected pointer is a test failure accompanied by a diagnostic report.

Range store and range insert helpers assert a caller supplied status code and, only on success, re-read every index across the closed interval to confirm each position returns the same expected pointer.
Singleton insertion helpers distinguish first use from collision: a fresh index must succeed while repeating the same index must fail with an existence conflict.
Index based checks expect singleton entries to carry a value encoding of the index itself restricted to the positive range, so each position validates against its own encoded address.
Occupancy for a maple node is defined by linkage or content: a node counts as non empty when its parent link is set or when any element of its fixed slot array holds a value.

Sequential construction tests start from an empty tree and insert an integer interval either ascending or descending, after each insertion revalidating all previously inserted positions plus the adjacent gap, requiring empty height initially and non empty height once populated, with the descending variant additionally toggling read copy update mode without changing height.

Boundary split tests insert sparsely spaced singletons using geometric halving or doubling around billion scale addresses from a page sized base, checking each probe centre is present with empty neighbours, then release the whole tree; lower, upper and middle variants select different start directions and edge constants including a zero entry.

Search validation covers forward iteration, reverse iteration and bounded queries over strided occupied intervals with gaps: present ranges return their encoded values in order, gaps and out of range limits return null, and repeated queries advance or terminate as specified.

Iteration cursor maintains an index interval plus status and advances monotonically under forward find and under reverse find or previous in the backward direction, supports reset to restart, pause to retain position across an unlock and relock pair, and erase to remove the current position while preserving neighbouring results.

Read side discipline pairs each iteration style with its guard: lock free scans run inside read copy update read sections, stateful scans hold the iterator lock across the loop and explicitly release before pause then reacquire afterwards, and empty area probes hold the state lock across the search with a reset between probes.

Allocation tests reserve the top of the address space, populate occupied intervals derived from page shifted address tables, verify enumerated holes match expected starts and lengths, then issue sized placement requests where forward search returns the lowest fitting gap and reverse search returns the highest fitting gap, with unsatisfiable sizes failing.
Reverse and forward allocation debug selectors default to disabled, gating extra diagnostic output during gap and request validation.

Overlap handling distinguishes insertion from overwrite: inserting an intersecting interval must fail with existence conflict while storing over it succeeds, including large spans and overwrites across tree levels, followed by targeted erases that leave nulls, structural validation and height checks before destruction.
Status contract uses existence conflict for duplicate insertion and busy for unsatisfiable allocation, with helpers asserting exact equality against the caller supplied expectation.

Address domain facts observed: maximum index and allocation ceiling bound placement, page granularity is twelve bits of shift, value encoding masks with the positive long maximum, reverse find fixture uses two hundred entries with stride ten and length six, singleton scan fixture uses two hundred fifty six entries, and bound split probes use a four thousand ninety six base with billion scale huge values.

Closed interval revalidation from start through end inclusive plus neighbour probes at minus one and plus one assume ordered bounds and representable neighbours; repeated full rescans after each insertion imply quadratic cost on large maxima and billion scale fixtures depend on validation and destroy to reclaim nodes.
